name: Home Assistant
description: Native Home Assistant display for LEDMatrix with validated setup flow, searchable entity discovery, smart presets, visual color controls, calendars, and real-time priority notifications.
author: airbornetrooper82573

versions.notes: Fix Home Assistant setup widgets to read and gate only fields inside the Home Assistant plugin form. Prevent collisions with identically named settings from other loaded plugins, including ha_token, ha_url, and verify_ssl.
Switch Home Assistant validation and discovery from urllib to requests with inherited proxy settings disabled, matching direct Raspberry Pi curl behavior more closely.
Trim pasted Home Assistant URL/token whitespace before authentication and show safe token-length diagnostics during validation.
Add connection diagnostics to the Home Assistant validator, including target endpoint, HTTP status, Home Assistant response text, and structured error details.

Fix connection validation and entity discovery response parsing. LEDMatrix returns plugin-action JSON directly when the script prints JSON; the widgets now accept that direct response instead of incorrectly expecting a nested output field.

Replace the discovery-first setup with a gated two-step flow. URL/token validation now happens first, other plugin settings remain locked until validation succeeds, changing credentials re-locks the page, and validation errors are surfaced directly.

Add smart presets based on Home Assistant domain/device class: automatic units, friendly state labels, garage/presence handling, and suggested person/vehicle/package/animal/motion notification wording.
Add searchable Home Assistant entity discovery with one-click add actions, visual color pickers instead of typed hex values, masked token/URL widgets, and easier alert state filters.
Add native live-priority notification takeover, per-rule priority, global/per-item text colors, and per-item scrolling controls.
Initial release with REST entity/calendar cards, WebSocket state-change notifications, wildcard rules, cooldowns, and wide-matrix scrolling.
